choice_basis: Statewide totals only: total applicants and permits drawn per drawing (AGFC does not publish per-hunt or per-zone applicant counts). Online applicant count is 'more than 6,600' per AGFC.

sources.label: AGFC: Eighteen draw Arkansas elk hunt permits (July 1, 2024)

notes: Online draw: 15 permits across Zones 2-4: Oct 7-11 hunt 9 antlerless (3 per zone); Oct 28-Nov 1 hunt 6 either-sex and 3 antlerless (2 ES + 1 antlerless per zone).
On-site draw at the Buffalo River Elk Festival: 3 permits, attendees only.
2025 and 2026 applicant counts not published in AGFC news releases found. 2025 had 18 online + 3 on-site permits; 2026 has 15 online + 3 on-site.
